newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end up on gains by blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end up on gains by blue chips.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher as blue chip shares gained on good corporate news, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index closed 42.69 points or 2.31 percent up at 1,847.77 on a turnover of 109.5 million taka.
Friday is the weekend in Bangladesh.
Of 113 traded issues 81 gained and 28 lost. Brokers said Bangladesh Tobacco rose 7.4 percent to 214.7 taka after an announcement that it would market imported Benson & Hedges cigarette.
"The small investors bought low priced scrips and few blue chips helping the market to move up," said one broker. Beximco Pharma rose 13 taka to 222 and Glaxco rose 3.0 to 185.
